request.subject: ICON:STATUS:SPLATTED

layers.text: Change only one thing: erase the face, the two eyes, the pink cheeks and the open mouth, so the middle of the splat is plain white whipped cream with no face; do not redraw anything else. Keep the white blob, its round splashes, the drip, the small sprinkles, shapes, colours, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
